cards.ex: She's a bit high-strung, so try not to startle her.
cards.exUz: U biroz asabiy, shuning uchun uni cho'chitmaslikka harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Tezda xafa bo'ladigan, juda asabiy odam.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed, she stuck to her guns and defended her proposal.
cards.exUz: Hamma rozi bo'lmagan bo'lsa ham, u o'z so'zida turdi va taklifini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizda qat'iy turish, boshqalarning fikriga qaramasdan.

cards.ex: He's usually a shrinking violet at parties, but after a few drinks, he loosens up.
cards.exUz: U odatda ziyofatlarda juda uyatchang, ammo bir nechta ichimlikdan keyin erkinlasha boshlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda uyatchang, kamtar va e'tibordan qochadigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a loose cannon in the office; you never know what he's going to do next.
cards.exUz: U ofisda boshboshdoq; uning keyingi nima qilishini hech qachon bilmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan va xavfli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Instead of complaining, he decided to take the bull by the horns and fix the problem himself.
cards.exUz: Shikoyat qilish o'rniga, u muammoni qat'iy hal qilishga va o'zi tuzatishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni qat'iy va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri hal qilish.

cards.ex: He's a glutton for punishment; he always volunteers for the most difficult tasks.
cards.exUz: U jazoga tayyor; u har doim eng qiyin vazifalarni bajarishga o'z xohishi bilan yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik yoki tanqidni qabul qilishdan zavqlanadigan odam.

cards.ex: Everyone knows she wears the trousers in that relationship.
cards.exUz: Hamma biladi, bu munosabatlarda u boshqaruvchi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarda yoki oilada hukmronlik qilmoq, boshqaruvchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I'm not one to hold a grudge, but I'll find a way to get my own back eventually.
cards.exUz: Men adovat saqlaydiganlardan emasman, lekin oxir-oqibat qandaydir yo'l bilan o'ch olaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir o'zingizga qilingan yomonlik uchun javob qaytarmoq.

cards.ex: You need to have a thick skin to survive in politics.
cards.exUz: Siyosatda omon qolish uchun bardoshli bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidga nisbatan sezgir bo'lmaslik, uni oson qabul qila olish.

cards.ex: He was a dark horse in the election, but he ended up winning.
cards.exUz: U saylovda kutilmagan g'olib edi, lekin oxir-oqibat g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan hech kim kutmagan, lekin muvaffaqiyatga erishgan odam.

cards.ex: Just mellow out and enjoy the music.
cards.exUz: Faqat tinchlaning va musiqadan zavqlaning.
cards.uzDef: Xotirjam va stresssiz bo'lish, asabiylashmaslik.

cards.ex: The CEO only hires yes-men who will agree with everything he says.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor faqat uning har bir so'ziga qo'shiladigan qo'l bolalarni yollaydi.
cards.uzDef: Doimo boshliqning fikriga qo'shiladigan odam, tanqid qilmaydigan.

cards.ex: Our neighbor is such a busybody; she's always gossiping about everyone.
cards.exUz: Qo'shnimiz juda aralashuvchi; u har doim hamma haqida g'iybat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning ishlariga doimiy ravishda aralashadigan odam.

cards.ex: It's important to keep your head in an emergency.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda vaziyatda xotirjam bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda xotirjam va o'zini tuta bilmoq.

cards.ex: He's a lone wolf and prefers to work on his own projects.
cards.exUz: U yakka bo'ri va o'z loyihalarida yolg'iz ishlashni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan ishlashni yoqtirmaydigan, yolg'iz ishlashni afzal ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: The company is known for playing hardball in negotiations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya muzokaralarda qattiq kurashishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qattiq va murosasiz usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: I thought he was my friend, but he turned out to be a fair-weather friend.
cards.exUz: Men uni do'stim deb o'yladim, lekin u soxta do'st bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi kunlarda do'st bo'ladigan, qiyin paytlarda yordam bermaydigan odam.

cards.ex: My dad is a creature of habit; he always has the same breakfast every morning.
cards.exUz: Mening dadam odatga ko'nikkan; u har kuni ertalab bir xil nonushta qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Har doim bir xil ishni qilishni yoqtiradigan odam.

cards.ex: The artist is always pushing the envelope with her experimental techniques.
cards.exUz: Rassom doimo o'zining eksperimental usullari bilan chegaralarni kengaytirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan tashqari, yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rmoq, chegaralarni kengaytmoq.

cards.ex: She's always been a shoulder to cry on when I'm feeling down.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni yomon his qilganimda, u har doim menga dardkash do'st bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Muammolaringizni aytib berishingiz mumkin bo'lgan, sizni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: I decided to take a back seat on this project and let someone else lead.
cards.exUz: Men bu loyihada chetda turishga va boshqasiga rahbarlik qilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Muhim bo'lmagan rolni bajarish, boshqalarga boshqaruvni topshirish.

cards.ex: She's such a social climber; she's always trying to impress important people.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik mansabparastki; u har doim muhim odamlarga taassurot qoldirishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori ijtimoiy maqomga erishish uchun harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Don't be such a wet blanket; let's just have some fun!
cards.exUz: Bunday zerikarli odam bo'lma; keling, shunchaki dam olaylik!
cards.uzDef: Xursandchilikni buzadigan, kayfiyatni tushiradigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a rolling stone; he's never stayed in one place for more than a year.
cards.exUz: U bir joyda turmaydigan; u hech qachon bir joyda bir yildan ortiq turmagan.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda joyini o'zgartiradigan, bir joyda uzoq turmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He's such a workaholic; he's always at the office, even on weekends.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik ishga berilib ketganki; u hatto dam olish kunlari ham ofisda.
cards.uzDef: Ishga juda berilib ketgan, dam olishni unutadigan odam.

cards.ex: She's such a chatterbox; she never stops talking.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik gapdonki; u hech qachon gapirishdan to'xtamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p gapiradigan, tinimsiz gapiradigan odam.

cards.ex: She's a real go-getter; she's always looking for new opportunities.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy faol; u har doim yangi imkoniyatlarni qidiradi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun harakat qiladigan, g'ayratli odam.

cards.ex: I believe in the principle of live and let live.
cards.exUz: Men yasha va yashattir tamoyiliga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning hayotiga aralashmaslik, o'zlaricha yashashga qo'yib berish.

cards.ex: We're on the same wavelength; we always agree on everything.
cards.exUz: Bizning fikrimiz bir joydan chiqadi; biz har doim hamma narsaga rozi bo'lamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrlash, bir-birini yaxshi tushunish.

cards.ex: He's a tough nut to crack, but I think I'm finally getting through to him.
cards.exUz: Uni tushunish qiyin, lekin menimcha, nihoyat unga yo'l topa oldim.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish yoki ishontirish qiyin bo'lgan odam.
